notes: BCVA was assessed in decimal and converted to logMAR for each patient (Methods); Table 4 gives logMAR only.

Post-baseline switching: 42 of 126 eyes were switched for non-response (14 after the 3-month loading phase, 28 after 16 ± 6 months), to steroids (34) or another anti-VEGF agent (8), with a second switch in 6 eyes. The article does not state that values after switching were removed or replaced; the series are taken as all treated eyes and include switched eyes.
The minimum follow-up of all 126 eyes was 1 year after the first injection, shorter than the last tabulated visit (4 years); later attrition is ordinary and noted per series.
Inclusion: macular edema at least 3 months after the occlusion, baseline BCVA between 0 and 1.4 logMAR; treatment-naive eyes (prior_treatment naive).
Bevacizumab used off-label in routine care, not declared as an experimental arm (role control).
Missing-visit handling is not stated (missing_data unstated).
Central macular thickness, subfoveal choroidal thickness and injection counts are reported but not extracted.
